members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id, used as the sidebar's value.

members.name: label
members.doc: Text next to the icon. It stays in the accessibility tree while the sidebar is a rail.

members.name: badge
members.doc: A count or short word at the end of the row; the rail shows it as a dot on the icon.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Keeps the row visible but not pressable.

types.name: BounceSidebarProps
types.doc: An app sidebar that switches between an icon rail and a full panel. The width rides a slightly bouncy spring, labels arrive one after another, and a solid accent marker glides to the active row.

members.name: secondaryItems
members.doc: Destinations pinned to the bottom, such as settings and help.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: Active row when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first item.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the id of the pressed row.

members.name: expanded
members.doc: Whether the full panel shows (controlled). False is the icon rail.

members.name: onExpandedChange
members.doc: Called when the toggle is pressed.

members.name: logo
members.doc: Brand mark for the header tile: a glyph or a letter.

members.name: title
members.doc: Product or workspace name beside the brand mark.

members.name: railWidth
members.doc: Width of the icon rail in pixels.

members.name: panelWidth
members.doc: Width of the full panel in pixels.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.
